verdict.rationale: Zapier's core value proposition is exactly this: prebuilt, vendor-maintained connectors to 9,000+ apps, accessible via Visual Builder, App Directory, and API/MCP, with community corroboration confirming breadth of integrations and ease for non-technical users (comm-9, comm-2, comm-6). Independent commentary also notes limitations (complex workflows, pricing, lack of code escape hatches) but these don't contradict the core connector-ecosystem claim. Missing for 10: fully independent audit of the 9,000+ figure and more recent hands-on validation beyond older HN threads.
